question: Each of D, E, F, G, H, I and J has a football match to participate on a different day of a week, starting from Monday to Sunday of the same week. E has a match on the day immediately after I. G has a match immediately after H. J has a match immediately after E, but not on Sunday. D has a match on Wednesday. Who among the following has a match on Sunday?
solution:
**Given:** 

Each of D, E, F, G, H, I and J has a football match to participate on a different day of a week, starting from Monday to Sunday of the same week.

**Solution: **

(1.)** **D has a match on Wednesday.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6a426b41fdad65c15d031f8ab145d0d1fed85fd5ab91ec75d1a6bce28e48117b.png] 

(2.) E has a match on the day immediately after I.

(3.) J has a match immediately after E, but not on Sunday. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b60e8c61bf8a74b724cd9f442885ff873d522a1c1e507a7bf609c17c8c9823f.png] 

Therefore , I surely will play on Thursday. so E on Friday and so on.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9028e432193608859d86ce19ed5a08eb1f74e8f4c37f84ce594887969ab813c3.png] 

(4.) G has a match immediately after H. H will definitely plays on Mondays because G will be plays immediately after H .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6280f0a373075bdb2cf148e658cf58836c83cd00941114cc47be8ee7f860bf2.png] 

(5.) Only Sunday is vacant . Thus F will participate on Sunday.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0ee32c580e907ea0fd9f21fc350d1fc96290bba840f592b13f1c6ba85abdd2e.png] 

Hence, 'F' has a match on Sunday.

**So 'option 3' is the correct answer.**
